# 📊 NBFC Daily Watch — Sunday, November 15, 2026

Morning edition for Sunday, 15 November 2026 (IST). Covers Saturday 14 Nov and the week just ended. Markets were shut on Saturday; stock and index figures are Friday 13 Nov NSE closes, and IBJA's latest rates are from Friday 13 Nov (PM).

## 🔴 URGENT / High Impact

### Muthoot Fincorp's Q2 FY27 results not yet on its investor page after the 14 Nov board date
Muthoot Fincorp's investor page lists a "Prior Intimation of Board Meeting to be held on November 14, 2026", the last day under SEBI LODR Regulation 52(1) for listed-debt issuers' September-quarter results. As of this morning the page carried no results file for the quarter ended 30 September 2026, and no tiered press source had reported the figures.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: the Q2 standalone results are the first public read on Muthoot Fincorp's gold book after a quarter in which listed peers reported sharp Stage 2 increases on monthly-interest and EMI gold products. The BSE filing under scrip 948016 could not be reached for this edition, so whether the results went to the exchange late on 14 Nov is not confirmed here.
Sources: [Muthoot Fincorp investors page](https://www.muthootfincorp.com/investors) · [SEBI LODR (Fifth Amendment) Regulations, 2021](https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebi_data/attachdocs/sep-2021/1631098532703.pdf)

### Bureau data put gold loans at ₹22.5 lakh crore, with 90-day overdues up to 0.3%
The Economic Times reports that outstanding gold loans hit a record ₹22.5 lakh crore in August 2026, almost three times the August 2023 level, while loans overdue by more than 90 days rose to 0.3% of the portfolio from 0.2% in March. TransUnion CIBIL data show ₹8.2 lakh crore of gold loans sanctioned in April–June, up 12% year on year, even as the number of loans originated fell 15% to 3.7 crore.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: the system data match what the lenders said on their calls: tickets are getting bigger and early delinquency is creeping up from a low base. ET also cites Macquarie's warning that some lenders are giving fresh gold loans to borrowers already overdue elsewhere, which puts bureau checks on gold borrowers on every analyst's list, including for Muthoot Fincorp.
Sources: [Economic Times: gold-loan boom and overdues](https://m.economictimes.com/industry/banking/finance/whats-under-all-that-glitter-glare-falls-on-booming-gold-loan-business-gold-loan-interest-rate-gold-prices/amp_articleshow/135800635.cms) · [Economic Times: lenders and short-tenure loans](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/satet-front/dodging-bullet-loans-hurt-gold-nbfcs/articleshow/135817183.cms)

## 🏢 Muthoot Fincorp in the market


### Muthoot Fincorp NCD status
No change since 14 Nov: Muthoot Fincorp's Tranche I NCDs trade on BSE in the "F" group, and no final allotted amount had appeared in a published source by this morning.
| Field | Value | As of |
|---|---|---|
| Status | Closed, 23 Oct – 5 Nov 2026; admitted to dealings on BSE from 11 Nov 2026, "F" group ([BSE notice](https://www.bseindia.com/downloads/UploadDocs/Notices/20261109-30/20261109-30.pdf)) | 2026-11-15 |
| Size | ₹500 crore (₹200 crore base + ₹300 crore green shoe); final allotted amount not seen in a published source | 2026-11-15 |
| Rating | CRISIL AA/Stable; Brickwork AA+/Stable | 2026-11-15 |
| Coupon | 8.56%–9.25% | 2026-11-15 |
| Bids | Bids stood at 2.67x at 17:00 IST on 5 Nov (BSE: 266.83% of base) ([BSE bid data](https://beta.bseindia.com/markets/publicIssues/DisplayIPO.aspx?IPONo=8058&id=4903&idtype=1&startdt=23%2FOct%2F2026&status=L&type=DPI)) | 2026-11-05 |
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: the deemed date of allotment and the final allotted amount had not been seen in a published source as of this edition.
Sources: [BSE notice 20261109-30](https://www.bseindia.com/downloads/UploadDocs/Notices/20261109-30/20261109-30.pdf)

Muthoot Microfin's board meets on Thursday 19 Nov to approve audited half-year accounts "for the preparation of restated consolidated financial statements" of Muthoot Fincorp ([NSE](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/muthootmicrofin_13112026182612_PriorintimationBoardMeeting19112026SD.pdf)). Muthoot Microfin closed the week at ₹167.43 on NSE, up 8.78% from ₹153.92 on 6 Nov ([NSE bhavcopy 13 Nov](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/products/content/sec_bhavdata_full_13112026.csv) · [NSE bhavcopy 6 Nov](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/products/content/sec_bhavdata_full_06112026.csv)).

## 📈 Market & Stock Summary

### Gold lenders end a four-session week mixed as Manappuram drops 5.35%
Between the 6 Nov and 13 Nov NSE closes (10 Nov was a trading holiday), the Nifty 50 rose 0.46% to 25,144.30 and Nifty Financial Services gained 2.09% to 27,855.50. Manappuram fell 5.35% to ₹308.00 and Muthoot Finance 1.01% to ₹2,840.00, while Bajaj Finance rose 2.69% to ₹1,117.00, IIFL Finance 2.45% to ₹641.10 and Shriram Finance 0.92% to ₹970.00.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: the two pure gold lenders lagged the financials index in the week Manappuram reported its Stage 2 jump and gold fell about 4.5%, while the diversified lenders rose. That gap is the market's current read on gold-loan asset quality, and it's the backdrop for Muthoot Fincorp's Q2 numbers and its planned IPO.
Sources: [NSE index closes 13 Nov](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/indices/ind_close_all_13112026.csv) · [NSE index closes 6 Nov](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/indices/ind_close_all_06112026.csv) · [NSE bhavcopy 13 Nov](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/products/content/sec_bhavdata_full_13112026.csv) · [NSE bhavcopy 6 Nov](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/products/content/sec_bhavdata_full_06112026.csv) · [Business Standard: 10 Nov holiday](https://www.business-standard.com/markets/news/samvat-2083-off-to-a-tepid-start-sensex-nifty-slip-smaller-cos-up-126110800423_1.html)

### Update: Gold ends its worst week since June; AGLOC's ₹10,574 ceiling runs through Monday
Reuters had spot gold at $3,879.71 an ounce at 2:05 pm ET on Friday, down about 4.5% for the week and its worst week since early June, while US December gold futures settled largely unchanged at $3,886.30. AGLOC's 85% ceiling of ₹10,574 a gram, on a jewellery reference price of ₹12,440, covers 14–16 Nov; IBJA's latest rates are Friday's, as it does not publish on Saturdays and Sundays.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: nothing moved over the weekend, so the AGLOC 85% per-gram figure stays ₹439 below the 7–11 Nov level until AGLOC posts its next period. Monday's IBJA print will be the first domestic rate since the weekly slide.
Sources: [AGLOC](https://www.agloc.org/) · [IBJA](https://ibjarates.com/) · [Mint (Reuters)](https://www.livemint.com/market/ratehike-bets-keep-gold-on-track-for-worst-week-in-four-months-11794598496469.html)

## 🏛️ RBI & Regulatory — Headlines Only

No new RBI, SEBI, IBBI or NHB instrument for NBFCs on Saturday 14 Nov. RBI's latest press releases are dated 13 Nov and its notifications page still ends at the 11 Nov Domestic Money Transfer Directions ([RBI press releases](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx) · [RBI notifications](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/NotificationUser.aspx)).

## 💰 Financial Results & Performance

No peer filed new results on Saturday. Muthoot Fincorp's Q2 status is the lead story above; Manappuram's call transcript was not yet on its investor-call page this morning ([Manappuram investor call](https://www.manappuram.com/investor-call)).

## ⚠️ Credit Rating Actions

No significant developments today on Muthoot Fincorp or the gold-loan peers.

## 🔄 Deals & M&A

### Godrej Capital raises ₹2,500 crore from Temasek as NBFCs line up fresh equity
Godrej Industries told the exchanges on 12 Nov that Temasek affiliate Jongsong Investments will put ₹2,500 crore into Godrej Capital at a valuation of up to ₹28,000 crore, leaving the Godrej group with about 80%, subject to regulatory approvals. Financial Express lists it alongside Bajaj Finance's ₹5,800 crore of promoter warrants, IIFL Finance's ₹6,414 crore raise and Piramal Finance's ₹1,750 crore of warrants, while ICRA's Deep Inder Singh said the agency does not see a broad-based requirement for fresh equity capital across the industry at this stage.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: Godrej Capital lists gold loans among its products and had ₹35,000 crore of AUM at 31 October, per Business Standard, so another group-backed lender in gold now has fresh capital. Muthoot Fincorp's planned ₹3,000 crore fresh issue would come to market in the same queue of NBFC equity raises.
Sources: [Godrej Industries Reg 30 filing](https://www.godrejindustries.com/uploads/BSENSECOMPANYANNOUNCEMENT_12112026_FSIGNED_20a7a6b166.pdf) · [Business Standard](https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/godrej-capital-raises-2-500-crore-from-temasek-at-28-000-crore-valuation-126111200763_1.html) · [Financial Express](https://www.financialexpress.com/business/banking-finance-nbfcs-turn-to-warrants-to-fund-next-phase-of-growth-4382436/) · [BusinessLine: Muthoot Fincorp funding and IPO](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/news/muthoot-fincorp-diversifies-funding-to-trim-borrowing-cost/article71695055.ece)

## 💻 Digital & Fintech

No significant developments today.

## 📉 NPA & Asset Quality

The system-wide gold-loan overdue data lead today's edition; see the second card above.

## 👤 Personnel & Leadership

No significant developments today.

## 🏘️ Sector Deep Dive — Sunday: weekly preview and sector health check

**The week ahead.** Monday 16 Nov is the last day of AGLOC's current ceiling period ([AGLOC](https://www.agloc.org/)). Wednesday 18 Nov is the record date for Manappuram's ₹1 interim dividend ([NSE](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/MANAPPURAM_12112026164223_MAFILOUTCOMEFINAL.pdf)). Thursday 19 Nov brings the Muthoot Microfin board meeting on audited half-year accounts for Muthoot Fincorp's restated consolidated statements ([NSE](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/muthootmicrofin_13112026182612_PriorintimationBoardMeeting19112026SD.pdf)). SEBI's Credit Risk-o-Meter for debt securities takes effect on Saturday 21 Nov ([SEBI](https://www.sebi.gov.in/legal/circulars/oct-2026/introduction-of-credit-risk-o-meter-as-an-additional-disclosure-mechanism-for-debt-securities_105081.html)). Further out, comments on RBI's draft priority-sector Directions are due on 26 Nov ([RBI](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=63925)), the MPC meets on 2–4 Dec ([RBI](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=62422)) and IIFL Finance holds its EGM on 4 Dec ([NSE](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/IIFL_12112026004505_SE_Intimation.pdf)).

**Health check.** Growth is still strong but the quality signals turned this week. Gold loans outstanding reached ₹22.5 lakh crore in August with 90-day overdues at 0.3% ([ET](https://m.economictimes.com/industry/banking/finance/whats-under-all-that-glitter-glare-falls-on-booming-gold-loan-business-gold-loan-interest-rate-gold-prices/amp_articleshow/135800635.cms)), and Muthoot Finance's standalone Stage 2 rose to ₹23,467 crore at September-end from ₹1,876 crore in June ([ET](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/satet-front/dodging-bullet-loans-hurt-gold-nbfcs/articleshow/135817183.cms)). October CPI inflation at 6.09% ([MoSPI](https://www.mospi.gov.in/uploads/latestReleases/latest_release_1794478693814_7c90e80f-9e64-4aa4-b44a-1dc727b0fed9_Press_Release_of_CPI_for_October_2026_.pdf)) puts a December rate hike in play, and spot gold lost about 4.5% in the week ([Mint (Reuters)](https://www.livemint.com/market/ratehike-bets-keep-gold-on-track-for-worst-week-in-four-months-11794598496469.html)). On capital, ICRA sees no broad-based need for fresh equity even as Bajaj, IIFL, Piramal and Godrej Capital raise it ([Financial Express](https://www.financialexpress.com/business/banking-finance-nbfcs-turn-to-warrants-to-fund-next-phase-of-growth-4382436/)).

# 📋 NBFC Regulatory Daily Report
**Date:** Sunday, 15 November 2026 (IST)

---

## 🔔 New Regulatory Updates Today

No new regulatory developments today. Saturday 14 Nov brought no RBI, SEBI, IBBI, NHB or FIU-IND instrument for NBFCs, and nothing addressed to banks that changes NBFC funding, risk weights, co-lending or gold loans.

### Watchlist sweep: nothing new for NBFCs on 14 Nov
RBI's press-release feed ends at its 13 Nov items (state and T-bill auction notices, September balance of payments, the Mobikwik penalty) and its notifications feed still ends at the 11 Nov Domestic Money Transfer Directions. SEBI's circulars page ends at the 11 Nov FATCA/CRS circular and its feed at 13 Nov recovery orders; NHB's latest postings are early-November tenders and notices, and FIU-IND's home page shows no new NBFC notice beyond the FINnet 2.0 non-compliance list as on 17 August 2026. IBBI's what's-new page did not render its list in this run, and a search found no new IBBI item.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: no direct change. The Reg 52 deadline for Q2 results passed on Saturday; the next dates are the Credit Risk-o-Meter start on 21 Nov and the PSL comment deadline on 26 Nov.
Sources: [RBI press releases](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx) · [RBI notifications](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/NotificationUser.aspx) · [SEBI circulars](https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebiweb/home/HomeAction.do?doListing=yes&sid=1&ssid=7&smid=0)

---

## Latest circulars (last 10 days)

cards.title: Muthoot Fincorp's Q2 FY27 results not yet on its investor page after the 14 Nov board date
cards.summary: Muthoot Fincorp's investor page lists a "Prior Intimation of Board Meeting to be held on November 14, 2026", the last day under SEBI LODR Regulation 52(1) for listed-debt issuers' September-quarter results. As of this morning the page carried no results file for the quarter ended 30 September 2026, and no tiered press source had reported the figures.
cards.impact: the Q2 standalone results are the first public read on Muthoot Fincorp's gold book after a quarter in which listed peers reported sharp Stage 2 increases on monthly-interest and EMI gold products. The BSE filing under scrip 948016 could not be reached for this edition, so whether the results went to the exchange late on 14 Nov is not confirmed here.

cards.title: Bureau data put gold loans at ₹22.5 lakh crore, with 90-day overdues up to 0.3%
cards.summary: The Economic Times reports that outstanding gold loans hit a record ₹22.5 lakh crore in August 2026, almost three times the August 2023 level, while loans overdue by more than 90 days rose to 0.3% of the portfolio from 0.2% in March. TransUnion CIBIL data show ₹8.2 lakh crore of gold loans sanctioned in April–June, up 12% year on year, even as the number of loans originated fell 15% to 3.7 crore.
cards.impact: the system data match what the lenders said on their calls: tickets are getting bigger and early delinquency is creeping up from a low base. ET also cites Macquarie's warning that some lenders are giving fresh gold loans to borrowers already overdue elsewhere, which puts bureau checks on gold borrowers on every analyst's list, including for Muthoot Fincorp.

cards.title: Gold lenders end a four-session week mixed as Manappuram drops 5.35%
cards.summary: Between the 6 Nov and 13 Nov NSE closes (10 Nov was a trading holiday), the Nifty 50 rose 0.46% to 25,144.30 and Nifty Financial Services gained 2.09% to 27,855.50. Manappuram fell 5.35% to ₹308.00 and Muthoot Finance 1.01% to ₹2,840.00, while Bajaj Finance rose 2.69% to ₹1,117.00, IIFL Finance 2.45% to ₹641.10 and Shriram Finance 0.92% to ₹970.00.
cards.impact: the two pure gold lenders lagged the financials index in the week Manappuram reported its Stage 2 jump and gold fell about 4.5%, while the diversified lenders rose. That gap is the market's current read on gold-loan asset quality, and it's the backdrop for Muthoot Fincorp's Q2 numbers and its planned IPO.

cards.title: Gold ends its worst week since June; AGLOC's ₹10,574 ceiling runs through Monday
cards.summary: Reuters had spot gold at $3,879.71 an ounce at 2:05 pm ET on Friday, down about 4.5% for the week and its worst week since early June, while US December gold futures settled largely unchanged at $3,886.30. AGLOC's 85% ceiling of ₹10,574 a gram, on a jewellery reference price of ₹12,440, covers 14–16 Nov; IBJA's latest rates are Friday's, as it does not publish on Saturdays and Sundays.
cards.impact: nothing moved over the weekend, so the AGLOC 85% per-gram figure stays ₹439 below the 7–11 Nov level until AGLOC posts its next period. Monday's IBJA print will be the first domestic rate since the weekly slide.

cards.title: Godrej Capital raises ₹2,500 crore from Temasek as NBFCs line up fresh equity
cards.summary: Godrej Industries told the exchanges on 12 Nov that Temasek affiliate Jongsong Investments will put ₹2,500 crore into Godrej Capital at a valuation of up to ₹28,000 crore, leaving the Godrej group with about 80%, subject to regulatory approvals. Financial Express lists it alongside Bajaj Finance's ₹5,800 crore of promoter warrants, IIFL Finance's ₹6,414 crore raise and Piramal Finance's ₹1,750 crore of warrants, while ICRA's Deep Inder Singh said the agency does not see a…
cards.impact: Godrej Capital lists gold loans among its products and had ₹35,000 crore of AUM at 31 October, per Business Standard, so another group-backed lender in gold now has fresh capital. Muthoot Fincorp's planned ₹3,000 crore fresh issue would come to market in the same queue of NBFC equity raises.
